name: FanXin Giant 3x3 (18.8cm)
description: Looking for a 3x3 that really stands out? Meet the FanXin Giant 3x3 – an enormous twisty puzzle that takes the classic 3x3 experience to new proportions! Measuring an eye-catching 18.8cm wide, this cube is perfect as a show-stopping display piece or an unforgettable hands-on challenge. Despite its jaw-dropping size, the FanXin Giant 3x3 isn’t just for show.
